Teach the hand skill shown in this recording.

RECORDED DEMONSTRATION (measured by the gloves):
Recording title: Worn Smartgloves II capture, right hand.
Demonstrating hand: right. Duration 25.1 s, 67 glove samples. The recorder cut it into 3 step(s) at the moments the hand was still.
Finger travel over the whole take (flexion range, degrees): thumb 35, index 64, middle 71, ring 69, little 58.
Steps, in order:
1. Step 1 (held still, 8.4 s): thumb half bent, index half bent, middle half bent, ring half bent, little half bent. Most bent: little at 37 degrees. Picture: step_00.jpg.
2. Step 2 (held still, 8.4 s): thumb straight, index straight, middle straight, ring straight, little straight. Most bent: little at 21 degrees. Picture: step_01.jpg.
3. Step 3 (held still, 8.4 s): thumb half bent, index straight, middle straight, ring curled, little half bent. Most bent: ring at 71 degrees. Picture: step_02.jpg.

lesson.title: Lesson: Hand Poses
lesson.summary: A 3-step lesson practicing different hand poses with the right hand.

steps.title: Lesson 1: Half Bent Pose
steps.instruction: Keep your thumb, index, middle, ring, and little fingers half bent.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Curled Ring Pose
steps.instruction: Curl your ring finger inward while keeping your index and middle fingers straight.
